meta.title: Replace random sampling with Farthest Point Sampling for better spatial coverage
meta.body_summary: Replace random sampling with Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) in hierarchical merge labelling to achieve better spatial coverage of opinions and 100x faster performance using a Rust-based library.

perf_labels.notes: Devin replaced random sampling with FPS in a single-file 21-line change; no human review occurred, and the PR was auto-closed by the bot after 7+ days of inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 21 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small change by absolute volume. It fits a minimal algorithmic improvement PR, but the outcome (closed without merge) aligns with the total lack of human review engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review or feedback was provided; the PR was automatically closed by the Devin bot after 7 days of inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) provides better spatial coverage of opinions and is claimed to be 100x faster than numpy for sampling, leading to more representative and efficient sampling.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed automatically by Devin bot due to inactivity for more than 7 days; no human maintainer interaction.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Minimal algorithmic change with no follow-up request; the PR stalled due to lack of maintainer engagement and was auto-closed, illustrating that even tiny, self-contained performance PRs can fail if no human review occurs.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Lint checks (ruff) passed, but no performance-related CI evidence.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides narrative benefits and a claimed 100x speed improvement over numpy, but no benchmark, profiling, or before/after spatial coverage metrics are included.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No review or regression issues occurred; PR was auto-closed without any fix cycle.

core_change_summary.description: In hierarchical_merge_labelling.py, replaced random sampling with fpsample.fps_sampling using x,y coordinates for sample selection, with a fallback to random sampling if coordinates are missing or FPS fails.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (b52d89d): replaced random sampling with FPS, added error handling, and maintained existing sampling_num parameter.
Follow-up commit (d320356): fixed ruff formatting issues (quotes, whitespace).

review_signals.summary: Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI assistance for write-access users.
CodeRabbit automatically skipped review because a bot user was detected.
Closed due to inactivity for more than 7 days.
